entities.title: C programs
entities.summary: Holds zazzle, the C invoker for the zazzled daemon, and a vendored copy of the lzfse-zazzcat compression library.
entities.purpose: A grouping folder for the repository's C code: zazzle/, and lzfse-zazzcat/, an unchanged copy of the LZFSE library from the lzfse-compression repository that free-disk-space compiles in.
boundaries: lzfse-zazzcat/ is changed only by copying a new version from its own repository.
